rationale: rst_b_ni changes only on clk_a and asynchronously controls state_o in the unrelated clk_b domain, so the reset-domain boundary is unsynchronized.
author: gpt-5.6-luna

mutation.description: Drove the destination asynchronous reset directly from the source-side clear state.
